d.title: Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko
d.jp: 炎の闘球女 ドッジ弾子
d.synopsis: Dodgeball is the most powerful combat ball game in history. Countless legends of this sport have been born, captivating people—and now, a new story begins. The protagonist is Ichigeki Danko, the daughter of Ichigeki Danpei. Unleashing the burning soul inherited from her father in the Reiwa era.
